name: bicep
description: LSP for Azure Bicep infrastructure-as-code files

lsp.install_linux: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin ~/.local/share/bicep-langserver && DOTNET_MAJOR=$(dotnet --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1); if [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then BICEP_TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Azure/bicep/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'"' -f4); else BICEP_TAG="v0.39.26"; fi; echo "Installing bicep-langserver $BICEP_TAG (dotnet $DOTNET_MAJOR)"; curl -sL "https://github.com/Azure/bicep/releases/download/$BICEP_TAG/bicep-langserver.zip" -o /tmp/bicep-langserver.zip && unzip -o /tmp/bicep-langserver.zip -d ~/.local/share/bicep-langserver && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec dotnet ~/.local/share/bicep-langserver/Bicep.LangServer.dll "$@"\n' > ~/.local/bin/bicep-langserver && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/bicep-langserver && rm /tmp/bicep-langserver.zip
lsp.install_macos: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin ~/.local/share/bicep-langserver && DOTNET_MAJOR=$(dotnet --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1); if [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then BICEP_TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Azure/bicep/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'"' -f4); else BICEP_TAG="v0.39.26"; fi; echo "Installing bicep-langserver $BICEP_TAG (dotnet $DOTNET_MAJOR)"; curl -sL "https://github.com/Azure/bicep/releases/download/$BICEP_TAG/bicep-langserver.zip" -o /tmp/bicep-langserver.zip && unzip -o /tmp/bicep-langserver.zip -d ~/.local/share/bicep-langserver && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec dotnet ~/.local/share/bicep-langserver/Bicep.LangServer.dll "$@"\n' > ~/.local/bin/bicep-langserver && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/bicep-langserver && rm /tmp/bicep-langserver.zip
lsp.install_windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dotnetCmd = Get-Command dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $dotnetCmd) { throw 'bicep-langserver needs the .NET SDK; dotnet not found on PATH' }; $dotnetVer = dotnet --version; $dotnetMajor = [int]($dotnetVer.Split('.')[0]); if ($dotnetMajor -ge 10) { $tag = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/Azure/bicep/releases/latest').tag_name } else { $tag = 'v0.39.26' }; $shareDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.local\share\bicep-langserver'; $binDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.local\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $shareDir | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $binDir | Out-Null; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'bicep-langserver.zip'; $url = 'https://github.com/Azure/bicep/releases/download/' + $tag + '/bicep-langserver.zip'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $shareDir -Force; $dll = Join-Path $shareDir 'Bicep.LangServer.dll'; $q = [char]34; $wrapper = Join-Path $binDir 'bicep-langserver.cmd'; Set-Content -Path $wrapper -Value ('@echo off' + [Environment]::NewLine + 'dotnet ' + $q + $dll + $q + ' %*') -Encoding ASCII; $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); if (($userPath -split ';') -notcontains $binDir) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ($userPath + ';' + $binDir), 'User'); Write-Host ('Added ' + $binDir + ' to your user PATH -- restart vimcode for bicep-langserver to be found.') }"

name: cpp
description: LSP and debugger for C and C++

lsp.install_windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $rel = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/clangd/clangd/releases/latest'; $asset = $rel.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like 'clangd-windows-*.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $asset) { throw 'no clangd-windows-*.zip asset in latest release' }; $destDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.local\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destDir | Out-Null; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP $asset.name; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $asset.browser_download_url -OutFile $zip; $extractDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'vimcode-clangd-extract'; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $extractDir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $extractDir -Force; $exe = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractDir -Recurse -Filter 'clangd.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $exe) { throw 'clangd.exe not found in downloaded archive' }; Copy-Item $exe.FullName (Join-Path $destDir 'clangd.exe') -Force"

name: csharp
description: LSP, debugger, and tooling for C# (.NET)

lsp.install_linux: DOTNET_MAJOR=$(dotnet --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1); if [ -z "$DOTNET_MAJOR" ]; then echo "csharp-ls needs .NET SDK 6+; no dotnet SDK found on PATH" >&2; exit 1; fi; CSLS_VERSION=""; if [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION=""; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 9 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.20.0"; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 8 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.16.0"; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 7 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.10.0"; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 6 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.5.7"; else echo "csharp-ls needs .NET SDK 6+; you have $DOTNET_MAJOR" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -n "$CSLS_VERSION" ]; then echo "Installing csharp-ls $CSLS_VERSION (newest release supporting dotnet $DOTNET_MAJOR)"; dotnet tool install -g csharp-ls --version "$CSLS_VERSION"; else echo "Installing csharp-ls latest (dotnet $DOTNET_MAJOR)"; dotnet tool install -g csharp-ls; fi
lsp.install_macos: DOTNET_MAJOR=$(dotnet --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1); if [ -z "$DOTNET_MAJOR" ]; then echo "csharp-ls needs .NET SDK 6+; no dotnet SDK found on PATH" >&2; exit 1; fi; CSLS_VERSION=""; if [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION=""; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 9 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.20.0"; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 8 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.16.0"; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 7 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.10.0"; elif [ "$DOTNET_MAJOR" -ge 6 ] 2>/dev/null; then CSLS_VERSION="0.5.7"; else echo "csharp-ls needs .NET SDK 6+; you have $DOTNET_MAJOR" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -n "$CSLS_VERSION" ]; then echo "Installing csharp-ls $CSLS_VERSION (newest release supporting dotnet $DOTNET_MAJOR)"; dotnet tool install -g csharp-ls --version "$CSLS_VERSION"; else echo "Installing csharp-ls latest (dotnet $DOTNET_MAJOR)"; dotnet tool install -g csharp-ls; fi

lsp.install_windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $shareDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.local\share\jdtls'; $binDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.local\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $shareDir | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $binDir | Out-Null; $tar = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'jdt-language-server-latest.tar.gz'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://download.eclipse.org/jdtls/snapshots/jdt-language-server-latest.tar.gz' -OutFile $tar; tar -xzf $tar -C $shareDir; $jdtlsBat = Join-Path $shareDir 'bin\jdtls.bat'; $q = [char]34; $wrapper = Join-Path $binDir 'jdtls.cmd'; Set-Content -Path $wrapper -Value ('@echo off' + [Environment]::NewLine + 'call ' + $q + $jdtlsBat + $q + ' %*') -Encoding ASCII; $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); if (($userPath -split ';') -notcontains $binDir) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ($userPath + ';' + $binDir), 'User'); Write-Host ('Added ' + $binDir + ' to your user PATH -- restart vimcode for jdtls to be found.') }"

lsp.install_windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $rel = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/LuaLS/lua-language-server/releases/latest'; $asset = $rel.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like '*win32-x64.zip' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $asset) { throw 'no *win32-x64.zip asset in latest release' }; $destDir = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.local\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destDir | Out-Null; $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP $asset.name; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $asset.browser_download_url -OutFile $zip; $extractDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'vimcode-lua-ls-extract'; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $extractDir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath $extractDir -Force; $exe = Get-ChildItem -Path $extractDir -Recurse -Filter 'lua-language-server.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $exe) { throw 'lua-language-server.exe not found in downloaded archive' }; Copy-Item $exe.FullName (Join-Path $destDir 'lua-language-server.exe') -Force"
